## Entity

```typescript
Entity?: Entity | null;
```

The live in-game item entity (rarity, components, world position) — the real object a script
should read, not a snapshot. `EntityId`/`EntityAddress`/`EntityPath` stay as denormalized
convenience scalars.

## WorldPosition

```typescript
WorldPosition: Vector3 | null;
```

The item's live world position, or `None` when the backing entity wrapper is contended —
Option-shaped exactly like [`Poe2PartyMemberAccessor::WorldPosition`], so a miss reads as
"position unavailable" instead of a garbage `Vec3::ZERO` (distance-to-origin).
